name: Miko-san☆Rescue~!! ~Nanika to H na Tsukimono Otoshi~
original_name: 巫女さん☆れすきゅ～‼︎ ～ナニかとHな憑きモノ堕とし～
source:
The protagonist is Mitsuru Moterugi, a fairly unpopular guy who visits a shrine in the hope that it will improve his luck with women. However, he accidentally destroys an altar which is said to hold evil spirits that would otherwise threaten the mortal world. When one of those spirits seemingly possesses one of the shrine maidens, Shiori Toyofuta, Mitsuru learns that the only way to exorcise the spirit is to imbue her with the spiritual power contained within his semen. After taking Shiori's virginity, Mitsuru sets out to vanquish the spirits who have possessed the other two shrine maidens, Shiori's little sister Kaori and Mei Abenose.

[From [url=https://www.mobygames.com/game/244537/]MobyGames[/url]]
translation:
主人公茂照充是一名不受欢迎的男孩，他前往神社，希望改善自己与女性相处的运气。然而，他意外破坏了一个据说封印着恶灵的祭坛；如果恶灵逃出，就会威胁现世。当其中一个恶灵似乎附身于巫女丰田诗织时，茂照得知，驱除恶灵的唯一方法，是用精液中蕴含的灵力灌注她的身体。在夺走诗织的处女后，茂照踏上了消灭另外两名巫女体内恶灵的旅程：诗织的妹妹香织，以及阿部乃濑芽衣。
